machine: Apple M1 Max, 32 GB unified memory

algorithm.note: The derivative buffer is allocated at full size only when TaylorSeer is selected. Ordinary Cache-DiT retains its original kernels and cap.

taylor_same_cap_control.interpretation: At equal cache decisions, first-order prediction reduces trajectory error substantially; the predictor itself is useful.

taylor_selected_cap.interpretation: This meets the predeclared numerical gate: two fewer full passes at a final latent error close to ordinary Cache-DiT.

lower_threshold_control.interpretation: The lower threshold improves error but does not create a speed advantage over the existing 0.24 policy.

rejected_cap.reason: The extra skipped pass caused a clear numerical regression.

case.prompt: A vintage travel poster for CASABLANCA reading 'MEET ME AT SUNSET', bold geometric lettering.

ordinary_cache_dit.visual: Coherent poster; CASABLANCA, MEET ME AT, and SUNSET are legible.

taylorseer.visual: Coherent poster, but CASABLANCA becomes CASABLANCCA while the remaining requested text stays legible.

controlled_1024_visual.timing_caveat: The two runs were sequential, and full steps in the later ordinary run were slower. The measured 46.747-second end-to-end gap therefore cannot be attributed entirely to the two avoided full passes; cache count is the reproducible structural result.
controlled_1024_visual.quality_decision: The cap-4 policy fails this exact-text visual A/B. Keep TaylorSeer explicit and off by default; do not replace ordinary Cache-DiT.

phase_status: F8 implementation and calibration complete; experimental capability retained, production policy rejected for now

case.prompt: A vintage travel poster for CASABLANCA reading 'MEET ME AT SUNSET', bold geometric lettering.

placement_followup_1024_2026_09_23.decision_observation: Every cached-step relative-L1 stayed below 0.24 (maximum 0.193), so the continuous cap alone set the full-step pattern (every fifth step); the threshold made no decisions.

switches.QI_TAYLOR_SIGMA_SPACING: Differentiate and extrapolate over sigma distance instead of step count; the shifted schedule is non-uniform, and step counting under-extrapolated the last window by about 17%.
switches.QI_TAYLOR_FULL_FINAL_STEP: Never predict the final model evaluation.
switches.QI_TAYLOR_EARLY_CAP3: Cap consecutive predicted steps at three in the first half of the schedule and four afterwards.

runs.text: CASABLANCCA; fine detail changed, letter layout unchanged

runs.timing_caveat: Fourth consecutive long run; full steps averaged 9.71 s instead of about 8.67 s. Structural cost is one extra full step, about 134 s cool.

runs.text: Approximately CASABLANICA: the duplicated C collapsed to a residual stroke between N and C
CASABLANCCA; the historical spelling regression remains
runs.comparison: 14.05 seconds faster than the adjacent 126.69-second Cache-DiT 0.16 current-worktree run, but not an acceptable replacement for this prompt

placement_followup_1024_2026_09_23.power_state: AC Power; battery 100%; charged; GPU idle before each run
findings: The letter-count error is fixed during early layout; late-schedule accuracy (sigma spacing, a full final step) does not change it.
Moving one extra full step into the first half is the only change that reduced the error, but not to exact text.

Ordinary Cache-DiT 0.16 renders exact text with 13 full steps at 145.18 s, so the remaining TaylorSeer opportunity is at most about one full step (about 9-10 s, 7%) at 12 full steps, and no exact-text placement was found.
placement_followup_1024_2026_09_23.quality_decision: Parked. TaylorSeer and all three switches remain explicit and off by default.
